Introduction

Location: Remote Germany or hybrid in Cluj (Romania) 

Please note that a portfolio is mandatory for this position. Applications submitted without a portfolio will not be considered.

At Impower GmbH, we are shaping the future of property management — simple, fast, and digital. Over 100,000 people manage more than 12 million apartments using processes that are often still manual, complex, and time-consuming. We are changing that with modern technology, clear workflows, and real practical value.

Our Cloud ERP brings complex processes such as accounting, banking, and property management into one intuitive platform. As our product continues to grow, great design plays a key role in turning this complexity into simple and efficient user experiences.

As a Remote Product Designer, you take ownership of key areas of our core product. Working in a well-established, distributed setup alongside our Head of Design, Product Owners, and Engineers, you turn complex workflows into intuitive solutions and drive design topics hands-on.


Your mission

  • Take ownership of product design across key areas of our platform — from problem discovery to final implementation

  • Translate complex, data-heavy workflows into simple, intuitive, and scalable user experiences

  • Develop user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-quality UI designs

  • Collaborate successfully and asynchronously in a remote setup with Product and Engineering to ship great features

  • Actively contribute to our design system to ensure high consistency across the entire platform

  • Proactively communicate your design decisions and actively seek feedback (via video calls, Loom, and Figma comments)


Your profile

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience in product design in a dynamic environment, ideally with B2B or SaaS products

  • Proven track record of working successfully in remote teams, demonstrating strong self-organization and proactive communication

  • Strong UX thinking combined with excellent UI skills and experience working with scalable design systems

  • Highly proficient in Figma and comfortable using modern AI and prototyping tools

  • You take ownership of complex problems and confidently drive them independently to a high-quality solution

  • Excellent communication skills in both German and English


Why us?

  • Visible impact: Shape a core product that helps thousands of people simplify complex property management processes every day

  • Real ownership: Take responsibility for important product areas and significantly influence how our platform evolves

  • Remote freedom: Enjoy the flexibility of working location-independently while being a fully integrated, highly valued part of our team

  • Close collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams through well-established remote workflows

  • Growth opportunities: Further develop your skills and actively help shape our design practices

  • Modern environment: Work with state-of-the-art tools and choose the hardware that works best for you (Mac or Windows)
